lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The drum goes into the harbour. The drone goes into the drum. One of the two men will be explaining a broken wrist to somebody who does not care about him at all.

lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: That's the second time this family's been told to move. It's the first time anybody stood in the alley for it, and I'd like you to know I've noticed which of those is rarer.

lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: Take the sign. It's older than me and it's coming off the wall either way this morning.

lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: The port's solicitor is here at nine with a cheque and a deed of sale. Which gives me until nine to decide what this corner is for.

choices.text: Put the block in the family's name. Don't sell.
Take the cheque. One corner is not worth a life.
It is not my corner to decide.
